READERS’ QUESTIONS

THE DETAILS MATTER.

Can my server unlock Pro for its members?

Yes. Server Complete is designed to sponsor individual Pro tools for members you select, including through a Discord role. Your plan’s sponsored-seat allowance applies. Server Tools covers the admin features without sponsoring member Pro.

What happens if I leave a sponsoring server?

Your saved personal data stays yours. Sponsored Pro access ends when you lose eligibility; free limits then apply unless you have your own Pro subscription. Individual Pro is designed to follow your Discord account across FutBot servers.

Can admins see my personal alerts?

Personal alert targets, private watchlists and investment records are designed to stay private. Server admins get configuration and usage totals. Production accounts and access controls are still to be connected.

PRIVACY & DEMO DATA

Know what you’re trying.

  • The marketing pages don’t collect payment details or connect to your EA or Discord account.
  • The dashboard demo stores watchlists, example alerts, feed settings and appearance choices in your browser. Its reset control removes those demo choices.
  • Example prices, chart series, activity and illustrated memberships are not live market or customer data.
  • The Lavia and Witzig card artwork comes from the supplied catalogue. Production data and a full privacy policy will be configured before account signup opens.
